image_description: A close-up view of an ornate, dark metal breastplate (part of a suit of armor). The surface is polished but appears aged or patinated, featuring intricate embossed floral or scrollwork designs on the upper chest area. Visible components include the main torso plate, a portion of the shoulder defense (pauldron) on the left with leather strapping, and a fauld (waist armor) at the bottom with riveted lames. The lighting creates strong specular highlights, emphasizing the curvature and metallic texture.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from generic metal objects or other armor types.
To analyze the realism of the metal reflections, patina, and embossed textures for any AI-generation smoothing or noise artifacts.
To verify the physical connectivity between the breastplate, pauldron, and fauld, ensuring no floating parts or impossible overlaps.
To ensure the embossed designs have consistent depth and do not exhibit 'melting' or perspective distortions common in AI generations.

focus_areas: Consistency of embossed pattern depth and perspective
Realism of metal reflections and specular highlights
Physical plausibility of strap attachments and rivets
Boundary sharpness between overlapping armor plates
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the embossed patterns: do they maintain consistent relief depth, or do they appear to 'melt' into the background? Check the rivets and straps for structural logic—are they attached to solid points? Verify if the reflection on the metal matches the implied environment/lighting without warping unnaturally.
